The worker's root-cause analysis is correct — the supported path is Vitis HLS export_design -> IP-XACT -> Vivado IP integrator. The delivered integration projection is methodologically SOUND: it is the sum of FIVE real, independently-synthesised component netlists (T0024 xmod_attn, T0025 gvsa_matmul, T0026 action_diff_head, T0029 vit_encoder, T0030 multi_rate_scheduler), and the modules are resource-independent so the sum is a valid pre-PnR system estimate. Accept 461 DSP (23.4%) / 82.4k LUT (9.2%) / 47 BRAM (2.4%) / 79 URAM (17.1%) as the v0 [HLS-EST] Table V system total. The headline claim HOLDS: MR-VLA fits VCK190 with >75% margin on every resource axis. The proper export_design + IP-integrator + place-and-route co-synth is deferred to a v1 task before camera-ready; it is not blocking for the current draft.
